coverage: >=80% total and each sign; MP10 >=16/20; CisSig/Xylinas full exact otherwise separately labelled partial; ratio all6
preprocessing: HGNC exact then unique stable IDs/unique alias; unmapped preserve original IDs; counts sum, normalized duplicate median; drop rows with nonfinite value across frozen population; retain zero-expressed genes

bulk.ssGSEA: GSVA2.4.9 alpha0.25 normalizeFALSE then divide each signature by its score range across full scoring population; exactly matches v1 single-set normalizeTRUE; constant range NA
bulk.native_z: gene z ddof1 across frozen reference samples, zero SD excludes member then coverage rule; no outcome-specific scaling
bulk.ratio: CPM/linear normalized or inverse2^author_log2 normalized intensity adapted; zero denominator NA; no log ratio

epi.official_AUCell: normAUC TRUE; ties random seed20261111, block256, Serial
epi.cycle: Seurat2019 S/G2M; AddModuleScore standard RNA normalized expression, ctrl=min(nS,nG2M), seed20261111
epi.partial: rank x/y/covariates within sample; intercept OLS, Pearson residuals; n>=50, rank/full degrees checks
epi.inference: patient equal Fisher-z; exact two-sided sign test H0 P(effect>0)=0.5, excludes zeros; bootstrap whole patients10000; unverified identities descriptive only
epi.pseudobulk: sum raw counts sample then normalize/score within dataset; verified repeated samples average scores within patient, unverified descriptive rho only
epi.random_sets: 100 sets matched to MP10 expression/detection quintile bins, seed20261111, rank correlations; state control not drug-specific

clinical.primary: continuous score per1SD nonresponse; independent cohort branches
clinical.Firth: use when n<40 or min(outcome count)<10 or glm separation/nonconvergence/extremeSE>10; profile penalized LR CI/P; otherwise glm Wald CI/P
clinical.adjustment: each cT/subtype/regimen/cycles separately, baseline-only; n>=40 and >=10 minority outcomes per predictor df; missing complete cases; no post-outcome covariates
clinical.LOO: GSE212810 MP10 primary good response, same reference mean/SD
clinical.encoding_flip: MP10 reciprocal OR and unchanged P

models.delta: mean R-mean P; cohort-specific units not pooled
models.r: Pearson point-biserial from RNA replicate points; two-sided t test, Fisher-z CI; >=2 each group and positive variance
models.hedges: pooledSD Hedges small-sample J correction; noncentral t inversion CI; flag pooledSD<1e-6
models.biological_unit: background/study; RNA repeats never independent resistance induction
models.five_lines: GSE171537 5 line effects equal mean with t CI, exact two-sided sign test

drug.primary: GDSC2 LN_IC50 Spearman model-level;10000 whole-model bootstrap CI
drug.secondary: GDSC1 and AUC separately; Pearson supplement; stableSIDM dedup median repeated assays
drug.IC50fold: only actual paired linear units, no selection concentration substitute

FDR: BH within frozen families across all estimable planned tests; blocked P stays NA; report planned and estimated n; additional BH across all primary unadjusted hypotheses. Sensitivity separate never substitutes primary
